preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 3 and 200,000.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U_i <= N and 1 <= V_i <= N for U_i, V_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P_i <= N and 1 <= Q_i <= N and not is_leaf(P_i) for P_i, Q_i in queries)
preconditions.description: All queries must have valid vertices P and Q, and P must not be a leaf vertex.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum lengths of cool sequences for each query, each on a separate line.
The maximum length of each cool sequence must be at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(max_length <= N for max_length in results)
postconditions.description: The maximum length of each cool sequence must not exceed the number of vertices N.
